payload.prompt: Turn this rough painted sketch into a photorealistic industrial design studio render of a handheld camera, same 3/4 front view, same composition and proportions. Concept: ENTROPY - what happens when light meets a black hole. A compact matte black core body (the black hole) with a large lens opening on the front. Soft, smooth, inflated light-grey tubes (rays of light) start calm and parallel at the left hand grip, flow over the top and twist around each other more and more chaotically as they approach the lens, then wrap into a thick glowing ring around the lens like an accretion disk, disappearing into the black core. Round shutter button on top of the grip, small USB-C port on the grip side. Matte soft-touch finish, seamless surfaces, clean white seamless background, soft studio lighting, product photography, high detail.
